# Capricor Therapeutics Reschedules Conference Call to Provide Deramiocel Update


November 23, 2026 6:30 am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_e012dfb0a531da323f531928d1ff602e/capricor/news/2026-11-23_Capricor_Therapeutics_Reschedules_Conference_Call__361.pdf)


SAN DIEGO, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Capricor Therapeutics](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=AlFUAhWqSXZrEW8spBIJHs8wzhp_cEBhn1EM0cRfq0j0reSqK6-Il9YwD24KC-Nqg-znMJc8OKVuKB4-M5SY7K2btNs__13SnK7Tl2Fim0Q=) (NASDAQ: CAPR), a biotechnology company developing transformative cell and exosome-based therapeutics for rare diseases, today announced that it has rescheduled its conference call originally planned for today, November 23, 2026. Details for the rescheduled call will be shared shortly. Given the significance of these matters, the Company is taking the time to prepare an update for shareholders and the Duchenne community on its response to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration’s (FDA) Complete Response Letter for Deramiocel and its next steps. Capricor stands firmly behind Deramiocel and the clinical data generated to date. The Company is actively preparing its regulatory response and remains fully committed to patients and families living with Duchenne.


**About Capricor Therapeutics**


Capricor Therapeutics (NASDAQ: CAPR) is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing cell and exosome-based therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases. Our lead product candidate, Deramiocel, is an allogeneic cardiac-derived cell therapy in late-stage development for the treatment of Duchenne muscular dystrophy, evaluated in clinical studies for its potential to preserve skeletal and cardiac muscle function. Capricor is also advancing its proprietary StealthX™ exosome platform for the targeted delivery of oligonucleotides, proteins, and small-molecule therapeutics across a range of diseases. At Capricor, we are committed to delivering new therapies for patients with rare diseases.
